title: Integrative Multi-Omics and Humanized Mouse Modelling to Predict Immunotherapy Response in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.

title: PLGA-loaded puerarin attenuates arsenic-induced liver injury through modulation of ferroptosis, oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptotic signaling.
snippet: Arsenic (AR) is an environmental and mining occupational toxicant with reported hepatotoxic effects. Ferroptosis has recently emerged as a critical mechanism involved in arsenic-induced hepatotoxicity. title: Integrating AI-Based Digital Pathology with Spatial Transcriptomics for Deeper Insight.
snippet: Histopathology preserves tissue architecture, whereas spatial transcriptomics measures gene expression within its native spatial context. Integrating these modalities with artificial intelligence (AI) can link morphology to spatial molecular states and scale spatial discoveries to routine pathology cohorts.
